sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of proceeds All of the ADSs offered
    by the selling shareholders pursuant to this prospectus will be sold by the selling shareholders. We will not receive any proceeds
    from such sales. However, to the extent the Warrants are exercised for cash, if at all, we will receive the exercise prices of those
    warrants. The exercise prices of the Series A-1 Warrants and Placement Agent Warrants may exceed the trading price of the ADSs. If
    the price of the ADSs is below the exercise prices of those warrants, we believe that holders of those warrants will be unlikely
    to exercise them, resulting in little to no cash proceeds to us. If all the Warrants were exercised for cash, we would receive gross
    proceeds of approximately $6.2 million. See “Use of Proceeds” in this prospectus for more information. Offering price The Pre-Funded Warrants
    have an exercise price of $0.0001
